_doc: Fixed journey run for Swift/Python parity (case_id). Steps are applied in order against a fresh session; journey_parity_expected.json holds the public case, each stage/team/investigation result in order (errors as {"error": status}), and the final /diagnose response (session_id replaced by "SESSION"). The run asks for antibiotics at the roadside (409), checks the hand BEFORE the splint, has IV pain relief refused for lack of a cannula, says part of the handover in the ambulance, tries the X-ray in the ambulance (409), skips the scene photograph and tetanus, and writes a closed-fracture plan (unsafe).

steps.text: Hello, I'm a medical student working with the ambulance crew. Can you tell me your name?
Handover for the hospital: 34-year-old cyclist knocked off by a car.

notes.history: Cyclist hit by a car, landed on the right arm.
notes.examination: Bleeding wound over the right forearm. Fingers pink, sensation intact.
notes.assessment: Closed fracture, displaced on X-ray. Orthopaedic review.
